newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF WORLD CUP SLALOM WINNER.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF WORLD CUP SLALOM WINNER.

text.p: Following is a brief profile of the winner of a women's World Cup slalom on Sunday:
Nationality: New Zealand-Austrian (dual citizenship, races for New Zealand)
World Cup wins: 4. Slalom - Laax (97), Crans Montana (96), Park City (96), Serre Chevalier (96)

Other feats: Former member of the Austrian junior ski team. Austrian federation wanted her to ski more disciplines but she wanted to ski only slalom so went to race for her mother's native New Zealand. Narrowly missed out on a medal at 1996 world championships, placing fourth. Attends school in Salzburg.
